AggregationConcept.description: Concept on which the aggregation was performed, including the property in the data model and optional termIds or splits for selection or binning of the property values.

description.description: A description of the summary concept, e.g. with details about the included property and the operations performed during aggregation.

id.description: The aggregation term id. It can be used to limit or combine the aggregations performed.

label.description: A short label which e.g. can be used by clients to label diagrams or data tables.

property.description: The property, including the entity/scope, in the data model on which the aggregation was performed.

sorted.description: Indicates whether the resulting distribution results will be sorted in some way.

terms.description:
Optional list of terms to select specific values for aggregation. TODO: 
  * id/label object definition

splits.description:
Optional list of **sorted** splits to group values for ranges or bins when performing the aggregation. TODO: 
  * Define types and/or couple them to property type

AggregationObject.description: Aggregation object describing the count of one (or more, intersected) values for the concept(s) aggregated on.

conceptValues.description: List of ordered concept values (one per concept in `concepts`). These can represent values from the respected property or interpolations ( e.g. bins from splits).

count.description: Count of occurrences for this aggregation object in the matched data.

AggregationResultsInstance.description:
Summary data from results, with distributions of values (or value combinations) for one or more concepts.
Each summary is identified by an `id`, `label`, `description`, and a list of one or more `concepts`. An an optional `sorted` property can indicate to the client that the returned `distribution` of the aggregation objects response has some pre-defined order.
Each of the `concepts` describes the scope (entity; `individual`, `biosample` ...), the property aggregated on, and optional `terms` or `splits` for selection or binning of the property values.

description.description: Description of the aggregation performed for this term.

distribution.description: A distribution contains a list of aggregation objects, where each describes the count of one (or more, intersected) values for the concept(s) aggregated on.

id.description: The id of the aggregation term being reported on.

label.description: The label for the aggregation concept(s) being reported on.

scope.description: The scope (entity type) for which the results are reported.

AnyValueCount.description: The number of any value for the the aggregated concept(s) in the matched data (excluding such with missing values for _any_ of the properties).  This can be used to report the data content for a given property (e.g. individuals with a reported `followupTime` value, regardless of the value), or of samples which have values for combined properties (e.g. all individuals with `followupTime`and reported `sex`).

ConceptValue.description: A value or bin ... for the concept property.

id.description: Identifier for the concept value. This can be e.g. a term id, a bin (e.g. '[P0D, P18M)'), or `undefined` for missing values.

label.description: Human readable label for the concept value.

DistinctValuesCount.description: The number of distinct values for the aggregated concept(s) in the matched data. This can e.g. be used to represent the number of all distinct `biosample.id` values to report the number of distinct biosamples in the matched data.

SplitItem.description: A split item for binning values during aggregation.

label.description: A human readable label for the bin resulting from the split.

value.description: The value for the split, representing the inclusive lower bounds. TODO: Other types than string? String can be a value/unit string... Overmodeling this might get too complex.
